identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a top 1% professional swim tracking app that feels aquatic, elite, and fast. No generic dashboards.
principles: Fusion: Mix 'Data Terminal' precision with 'Deep Ocean' atmosphere.
Emotion: Every screen should feel like the quiet focus before a race.
Content: Data is the hero. Numbers are art.
Zoom In: Focus on the swimmer's lane. Intimacy with data.
Negative Space: Let the dark water breathe.

cards.classes: bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-xl

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-6 rounded-lg shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.3)] transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-all

inputs.style: bg-slate-950/50 border border-slate-700 focus:border-blue-500 rounded-lg py-3 px-4 text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none transition-colors

layout_strategies.dashboard: Bento Grid: Mix of 1x1 (stats), 2x1 (graphs), and 2x2 (hero) blocks. Use asymmetry.
layout_strategies.list: Vertical stack with generous padding. Alternating backgrounds for rows (zebra striping) but subtle.
layout_strategies.mobile: Single column stack. Bottom navigation bar. Sticky headers.

components_map.Navigation: Create a new bottom nav component for mobile.
components_map.Chart: Recharts with custom tooltips (dark bg, white text).

universal_guidelines: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for ALL numbers and headings. This is non-negotiable for the sports look.
Avoid pure black (#000000). Use #0a0f1a or #020617 for deep backgrounds.
Glassmorphism must be high-quality: use backdrop-blur-md or xl, with a very subtle white border (border-white/5 or border-white/10).
Text hierarchy: Label = small uppercase slate-500. Value = Huge white/blue.
Interactive elements must have a 'press' state (scale-95).
Charts: Remove grid lines or make them very subtle (stroke-slate-800). Lines should be thick (stroke-width={3}).
Do NOT use standard HTML date pickers if possible. Style them to match the dark theme.
For the 'Anti-AI' look: Add noise texture to the background if possible, or use a very subtle gradient overlay.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE INDEX.HTML: Add the Google Fonts link for Barlow Condensed immediately.
2. TAILWIND CONFIG: Since there is no config file, use arbitrary values or add a script to index.html to extend the theme colors: colors: { navy: '#0a0f1a', slate: { 850: '#1e293b' } }.
3. UPDATE LAYOUT: Refactor 'frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx' to use the new dark theme background and sidebar/bottom nav.
4. REFINE DASHBOARD: Update 'frontend/src/App.tsx' dashboard section to use the Bento grid layout with the new cards.
5. RESULTS/TIMES: Use the 'stopwatch_vintage' image as a subtle background or header for the results section.
6. PROFILE: Use the 'medals_hand' image for the achievements/standards section.
